scope: Arm VM software-integration evidence (ADR-0003 D5, hardware-acceptance V2): Debian 13.7 arm64 VM on VMware Fusion (Apple silicon host), systemd 257 as PID 1, kernel 6.12 arm64. Not Arm hardware, not the deployment baseline (ADR-0002 is Debian 13 / amd64), not hardware-gate evidence, not production activation or admission (ADR-0005). Build in a container, install on the VM.

source.worktree: clean (git clone of the commit, uid 1001, umask 022)

build_container.image: debian:trixie (linux/arm64, native aarch64 on the colima default context of the macOS host; --rm)
build_container.build_user: uid 1001, umask 022, clean git clone of the commit
build_container.digests: omitted from this record (hardware-acceptance §5); the bundle report on the VM checked every member against its manifest sha256

edge_slot_at_build.command: build_offline_bundle.py --target debian-13-aarch64-cp313 ... --edge-package <aarch64 Edge package dir> --edge-source TEXT
edge_slot_at_build.result: refused, exit 2: target debian-13-aarch64-cp313 carries no Edge package: the reviewed Edge pin is for another CPU and no Edge pin exists for this one (ADR-0003 R4, ADR-0005)

vm.starting_state: VM snapshot S0 with the residue of earlier Azazel installs removed by hand (/opt/azazel*, /etc/azazel*, /var/lib/azazel*, /usr/libexec/azazel, azazel units, AppArmor profiles, az* accounts and groups). Not a freshly installed OS. An /etc/crypttab entry from an earlier commissioning rehearsal was left in place; its systemd-cryptsetup unit fails at every boot (pre-existing, before this install) and makes the boot wait for its timeout.

network.method: both VM NICs are VMware host-only; the VM has no IPv4 or IPv6 default route; nothing was changed for this run (the state of S0). The only reachable peer is the macOS host on the host-only subnet, used for ssh control and to copy the bundle.

vm.compiler: absent (no gcc on the VM during V2)
vm.verifier: tools/offline_bundle.py from a root-owned git clone of the reviewed commit at a separate path, run with python3 -I as root (never from inside the bundle)
vm.tampered_copy: refused before extraction (one bit flipped near the end: gzip data check failed); destination not created

edge_slot_at_verify.input: a lab-target bundle whose Edge slot was filled by a one-off harness that replaced the builder's two Edge refusals with no-ops in its own process (crafted adversarial input, not a product path); the Edge files were a real aarch64 Edge package
edge_slot_at_verify.verify: refused, exit 2: target debian-13-aarch64-cp313 carries no Edge package ... (ADR-0003 R4, ADR-0005); destination not created
edge_slot_at_verify.install: refused, exit 2 with the same reason; neither the tree nor /opt/azazel-nexus/venv was created

report.integrity: every declared member matched its manifest size and sha256
report.own_wheels: azazel-nexus and azazel-nexus-runtime are pinned by version only (exact string match against the reviewed pyproject files); their content is built per bundle and is unauthenticated until bundle signing exists
report.purpose_note: lab-software-verification target: VM software-integration evidence at most; never hardware-gate evidence, a deployment-baseline install or a production admission (ADR-0005)

signature.reason: unsigned: the bundle carries no MANIFEST.sig and no bundle signature is defined

after_install.disabled_or_static: azazel-ui.socket, the observe timers disabled; their services, decoy-verify and the trip target static; none active
after_install.imports_checked: azazel_nexus, azazel_nexus_runtime, _bootstrap_deadline (cpython-313-aarch64-linux-gnu.so), yaml with CSafeLoader, dbus_next, pydantic_core 2.46.5, azazel_fabric.provisioning_contracts: ok

after_reboot.how: systemctl reboot; a new kernel boot id was confirmed
after_reboot.activation_pass: azazel-activated.service Result=success: az-activated completed safely: granted=0, withheld=16, reasons=no_generation
after_reboot.units: every governed unit still masked and inactive; nothing of Azazel-Nexus running
after_reboot.system_state: degraded only by the pre-existing systemd-cryptsetup unit noted in starting_state

limitations: Arm VM (VMware Fusion on Apple silicon): VM software-integration evidence only; not Arm hardware, not hardware-gate evidence, not the deployment baseline
Build in a container on the colima aarch64 VM, not on a separate Arm build host
The VM started from S0 with earlier Azazel residue removed by hand, not from a fresh OS install
Network isolation is the VM's host-only NICs with no default route; the host-only link to the macOS host remained up for control
Bundle unsigned; bundle_authenticated false; hashes are integrity, not authenticity
No Edge package, .deb set, model or Knowledge asset carried; no arm64 Edge pin exists
No activation, commissioning or service start was exercised after the install (the boot's pass granted nothing, as designed)
